panels.name: A vintage candy-apple red Cadillac convertible rolls
panels.summary: A vintage candy-apple red Cadillac convertible rolls slowly down the muddy dirt main street of Blackwater, a sleepy, remote Mississippi Delta swamp town draped in heavy Spanish moss.
panels.caption: He rolled into Blackwater with nothing but his car and no name.
panels.shotType: Establishing Wide Shot, early morning fog
panels.prompt: Wide cinematic horizontal establishing shot, atmospheric dawn. A vintage candy-apple red Cadillac convertible with classic chrome tailfins, chrome grille, and mud-splashed lower rocker panels rolls slowly down the muddy dirt main road into Blackwater, a remote, sleepy Mississippi Delta swamp town. Behind the chrome steering wheel of the red convertible sits the 29-year-old traveler in a dark western jacket. Ancient cypress and live oak trees draped in thick, hanging Spanish moss loom over weathered wooden general stores, rusted tin roofs, and ramshackle shacks.
